minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit to rebuild a storm-damaged Crocker Avenue porch two feet deeper.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a single application for a special permit for a dimensional variation to rebuild a front porch destroyed by a falling tree and extend it two feet. A neighbor spoke in favor. The board discussed the town line and agreed the porch must stay a porch and not be enclosed. A motion to grant was made and seconded, and the chair described the vote as unanimous.

public_comment.topic: Neighbor at 17 Crocker supported the porch request, saying the street is quiet with little traffic.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for a dimensional variation of the front setback to rebuild a porch at 5 Crocker Avenue; the chair described the vote as unanimous.
The board agreed the porch must remain a covered porch and may not be enclosed into living space.
The porch was destroyed by a falling tree, and the application extends it two feet deeper than before.
A neighbor at 17 Crocker spoke in favor of the request, saying the street is quiet with little traffic.

why_it_matters: The permit lets one homeowner rebuild closer to the street than the setback normally allows, and the no-enclosure condition keeps the added space from becoming living area, which would change how the lot is used.
